title: Memory budget verification (Zephyr)
notes: Validated the constrained STM32WL target locally with Zephyr SDK 0.16.8/GCC 12.2 in /Volumes/Attic/Cache/project-LICHEN/memory-budget-l1qw-1-11-4. Scoped component builds succeeded for modules/lichen/subsys/lichen/link/all and modules/lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/all. GNU arm-zephyr-eabi-size totals: link text/data/bss=10109/0/0; L2=23824/255/13032; combined conservative pre-GC flash=34188 bytes and RAM=13287 bytes, passing protocol budgets 143360/20480. Concrete constrained allocations: guarded LoRa RX stack .noinit=8256 bytes, four-frame TX queue/pool .bss=1248 bytes, frame_pool.c.obj text=480 bytes with no separate global RAM. Added scripts/check_zephyr_memory.py JSON gate (exit 0 pass, 1 over budget, 2 measurement error), scripts/test_check_zephyr_memory.py, and documented component/release gates in lichen/README.md. Validation: pytest 8 passed; ruff clean; git diff --check clean; real archives passed at 143360/20480 and correctly failed both resources at 34187/13286. A full local Zephyr 4.1 puck link is unavailable because pre-existing unrelated source/toolchain mismatches fail earlier (CoAP client struct send_mutex API mismatch plus upstream warning-as-error/Monocypher stack warning); the README explicitly requires full release ELF numbers from pinned v3.7 and the new gate accepts that ELF. No AWS state was used or touched.
close_reason: Constrained-target Link/L2 memory measured within budget and machine-checkable archive/release-ELF gates added with passing/fail-closed tests.
